description: App-side core of the share link: new BuddyConstants, the pure JVM-testable seams (ShareLinkValidity, ShareLifetime, ShareToken) + the ShareLink data class with their unit tests, the three new BuddyRepository methods (interface + NoOp inert impl + FirebaseBuddyRepository real impl), and the BuddyLocationService writer hook that mirrors the latest fix into the active share doc. This is the foundation the UX feature (FEAT-002) depends on. Independent of the backend/web feature (FEAT-003) except that the Firebase impl's writes are only EXERCISED once the rules are deployed by the user; the code compiles and the pure logic is fully testable without any deploy.
steps: In app/src/main/java/com/example/joggingapp/BuddyConstants.kt add: SHARE_LIFETIME_MS = 4 * 60 * 60 * 1000L (4h), SHARE_PATH_PREFIX = "s", and three jog_prefs keys PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_TOKEN = "buddy_share_token", PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_EXPIRES_AT = "buddy_share_expires_at", PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_LABEL = "buddy_share_label". Add a comment that the rule's 5h create ceiling must stay >= SHARE_LIFETIME_MS. Reuse the existing INVITE_HTTPS_HOST for the URL (do not add a new host).

In app/src/main/java/com/example/joggingapp/BuddyLinkDecisions.kt (alongside CheerRateLimit/BuddyLocate) add object ShareLinkValidity with data class Decision(val readable: Boolean, val reason: Reason), enum Reason { OK, NO_TOKEN, REVOKED, EXPIRED }, and fun decide(hasToken: Boolean, expiresAtMs: Long, revoked: Boolean, nowMs: Long): Decision using ordering !hasToken->NO_TOKEN, revoked->REVOKED, nowMs>=expiresAtMs->EXPIRED, else OK (boundary nowMs==expiresAtMs is EXPIRED, mirroring the rule's strict request.time < expiresAt). Add object ShareLifetime with expiresAt(createdAtMs) = createdAtMs + BuddyConstants.SHARE_LIFETIME_MS and remainingMs(expiresAtMs, nowMs) = (expiresAtMs - nowMs).coerceAtLeast(0L). Add object ShareToken with generate(random: java.security.SecureRandom = java.security.SecureRandom()): String that fills 16 bytes and returns java.util.Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(bytes) (MUST be java.util.Base64, NOT android.util.Base64, so it stays JVM-pure).
Add data class ShareLink(val token: String, val expiresAtMs: Long) in a main-source file (BuddyLinkDecisions.kt or BuddyModels.kt) so NoOpBuddyRepository can reference it.

Create JVM unit tests (JUnit4, BuddyLinkDecisionsTest.kt style) at app/src/test/java/com/example/joggingapp/ShareLinkValidityTest.kt, ShareLifetimeTest.kt, ShareTokenTest.kt. ShareLinkValidity: OK, NO_TOKEN, REVOKED, EXPIRED, the nowMs==expiresAtMs boundary (==EXPIRED), and revoked-beats-expired ordering. ShareLifetime: expiresAt adds the constant; remainingMs normal + clamp-at-zero. ShareToken: generated length == 22, charset matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$, two generate() calls differ.

In app/src/main/java/com/example/joggingapp/BuddyRepository.kt add to the interface: suspend fun createShareLink(label: String?): BuddyResult<ShareLink>; suspend fun writeShareFix(token: String, lat: Double, lon: Double, atMs: Long, expiresAtMs: Long, label: String?): BuddyResult<Unit>; suspend fun revokeShareLink(token: String): BuddyResult<Unit>. Mirror the existing kdoc style.
In app/src/main/java/com/example/joggingapp/NoOpBuddyRepository.kt add inert overrides for all three returning unavailable() (BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE).

In app/src/firebase/java/com/example/joggingapp/FirebaseBuddyRepository.kt implement the three methods reusing db, myAppId, mapError, the runCatching{...}.getOrElse{ mapError(it) } idiom, and the com.google.firebase.Timestamp(java.util.Date(ms)) conversion as writeMyLocation does. createShareLink: me = myAppId ?: return Failure(NOT_FOUND); token = ShareToken.generate(); expiresAtMs = ShareLifetime.expiresAt(System.currentTimeMillis()); write shareOwners/{token} FIRST {ownerAppId:me, createdAt:FieldValue.serverTimestamp(), expiresAt:Timestamp(Date(expiresAtMs))} and await(); then create control-only shares/{token} {expiresAt:Timestamp(Date(expiresAtMs)), revoked:false, label? (trimmed, capped <=40)} with NO lat/lon/at and await(); if the shares create throws, best-effort delete the orphan shareOwners/{token}; persist token+expiresAtMs(+label) to jog_prefs; return Success(ShareLink(token, expiresAtMs)). writeShareFix: a MERGE update (SetOptions.merge() or update()) of ONLY lat, lon, at(as Timestamp) plus the UNCHANGED expiresAt (re-sent as Timestamp so the write-once rule equality holds) and optional label; NEVER write revoked. Add a one-line comment at the write site that expiresAtMs MUST be the verbatim prefs PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_EXPIRES_AT value, never recomputed as now+lifetime (review NIT 1). revokeShareLink: shares/{token}.update("revoked", true) first, then clear the three prefs keys, then best-effort delete shares/{token} and shareOwners/{token}.

In app/src/main/java/com/example/joggingapp/BuddyLocationService.kt, inside writeFix's existing scope.launch and AFTER the existing repo.writeMyLocation(...) call, read PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_TOKEN / PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_EXPIRES_AT / PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_LABEL from getSharedPreferences("jog_prefs", MODE_PRIVATE), compute ShareLinkValidity.decide(hasToken = token != null, expiresAtMs = expiresAt, revoked = false, nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis()), and when token != null && validity.readable call repo.writeShareFix(token, loc.latitude, loc.longitude, now, expiresAt, label). Keep the same non-fatal SERVICE-level log-on-failure as writeMyLocation. Do NOT change enterForeground()/startForeground ordering.
acceptance_criteria: .\gradlew.bat :app:compileDebugKotlin succeeds (main set compiles including NoOp overrides and the service hook).
.\gradlew.bat :app:testDebugUnitTest passes, including the new ShareLinkValidityTest / ShareLifetimeTest / ShareTokenTest, and the existing suite stays green.
ShareToken.generate() returns a 22-char URL-safe-Base64 string and two calls differ; ShareLinkValidity.decide orders token->revoked->expired with the nowMs==expiresAtMs boundary denying.

BuddyLocationService still enters the foreground unconditionally before any early return (startForeground contract unchanged); the share write is additive inside writeFix and never throws into the service.
verification: Run from the worktree root: .\gradlew.bat :app:lintDebug (confirm no new warnings on the touched files)
findings:
DONE. Verification (from worktree root): :app:compileDebugKotlin, :app:assembleDebug, :app:testDebugUnitTest, :app:lintDebug all BUILD SUCCESSFUL, no errors, no new warnings (the pre-existing osmdroid cacheManagerHandlingMessage + MainActivity warnings are unchanged). New ShareLinkValidityTest/ShareLifetimeTest/ShareTokenTest pass; existing suite stays green.

DEVIATION (behavior-preserving) — ShareToken.generate: the spec mandated java.util.Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding(), but that API is API 26+ while app minSdk is 24, so lintDebug raised 3 NEW NewApi errors on that single line. Replaced it with a hand-rolled pure-Kotlin RFC 4648 §5 URL-safe (no-padding) table encoder in ShareToken. Output is IDENTICAL (same 22-char ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ token for 16 random bytes), still JVM-pure (no android.util.Base64, no Robolectric). ShareTokenTest asserts length==22 + URL-safe charset + two calls differ, which lock the equivalence. FEAT-002/003 callers see no difference.

ENV SETUP (not committed): the worktree lacked local.properties (git-ignored, not carried into worktrees), so gradle couldn't find the Android SDK. Created .worktrees/share-link/local.properties with sdk.dir copied from the parent workspace (C:\Users\INFINITI\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk). It is git-ignored (verified) and NOT part of the commit.

FOR LATER STEPS: active-share state lives in jog_prefs ("jog_prefs", MODE_PRIVATE) under BuddyConstants.PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_TOKEN / PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_EXPIRES_AT / PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_LABEL. createShareLink writes shareOwners/{token} FIRST then control-only shares/{token} {expiresAt, revoked:false, label?} (no lat/lon/at) and persists prefs; it orphan-cleans shareOwners if the shares create throws. writeShareFix is a merge of lat/lon/at + the VERBATIM expiresAt (never recomputed) + optional label, never 'revoked' — the BuddyLocationService.writeFix hook passes prefs' PREFS_ACTIVE_SHARE_EXPIRES_AT unchanged and gates on ShareLinkValidity.decide(revoked=false). revokeShareLink sets revoked=true first, clears the 3 prefs, then best-effort deletes shares/{token} + shareOwners/{token}. FEAT-003 must deploy Firestore rules for shares/shareOwners (<=5h create ceiling, >= SHARE_LIFETIME_MS=4h; write-once expiresAt equality) and a /s/{token} hosting rewrite + reader page. Share URL host reuses BuddyConstants.INVITE_HTTPS_HOST with SHARE_PATH_PREFIX="s". FEAT-002 (UX) must add the BuddyLinkController activeShare state + createShareLink/revokeShareLink actions + shareUrl helper, the BuddyLinkSection card, and AppStrings EN/EL — none of that was done here.
